unitTitle: See New Places, Meet New Faces

exercises.instructionEn: Circle the wrong word. IN MY TOWN ...
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — BU MAShQ TESKARI:
  Odatda TO'G'RI variantni tanlaysiz.
  Bu yerda esa NOTO'G'RI so'zni topish kerak.

Har qatorda TO'RT sifat bor — uchtasi otga
MOS KELADI, bittasi esa MOS KELMAYDI.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (noto'g'ri so'zlar):
  1  HEAVY      (building)
  2  POLLUTED   (hotel)
  3  CROWDED    (nightlife)
  4  DELICIOUS  (restaurant)
  5  FRIENDLY   (streets)


HAR BIRI NEGA NOTO'G'RI:

  1  'The museum is a ...... BUILDING.'
     tall ✓  small ✓  modern ✓  HEAVY ✗
     'heavy' = og'ir — BINO haqida aytilmaydi.
     'heavy' odatda: heavy traffic, heavy rain,
     heavy bag.

  2  'You can stay in a ...... HOTEL.'
     luxurious ✓  cheap ✓  expensive ✓  POLLUTED ✗
     'polluted' = ifloslangan — HAVO, SUV, ShAHAR
     haqida aytiladi, mehmonxona haqida emas.

  3  'The NIGHTLIFE is ...... .'
     interesting ✓  dull ✓  boring ✓  CROWDED ✗
     'crowded' = gavjum — JOY haqida aytiladi
     (a crowded street, a crowded city),
     'nightlife' esa TUShUNChA.

  4  'You can have dinner in a very ......
      RESTAURANT.'
     romantic ✓  clean ✓  famous ✓  DELICIOUS ✗
     'delicious' = mazali — faqat OVQAT haqida.
     'a delicious dish' ✓ / 'a delicious
     restaurant' ✗

  5  'The STREETS are ...... .'
     dangerous ✓  safe ✓  crowded ✓  FRIENDLY ✗
     'friendly' = do'stona — ODAMLAR haqida
     aytiladi ('friendly people'), ko'chalar
     haqida emas.


UMUMIY QOIDA — COLLOCATION:
  Ingliz tilida ma'lum sifatlar ma'lum otlar
  bilan BIRGA keladi. Bu 'collocation' deyiladi.
  Grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri bo'lsa ham, noto'g'ri
  juftlik G'ALATI eshitiladi.

  Coursebook 82-betdagi 1-mashq ham aynan shu
  haqda edi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  luxurious = hashamatli
  dull      = zerikarli ('boring' ning sinonimi)
  tasty     = mazali

items.textEn: 1  The museum is a tall / small / modern / heavy building.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: HEAVY.
'heavy' = og'ir — BINO haqida aytilmaydi.
'heavy' odatda: heavy TRAFFIC (zich transport),
heavy RAIN (kuchli yomg'ir), heavy BAG (og'ir sumka).
Tall, small, modern — hammasi bino uchun to'g'ri.

items.textEn: 2  You can stay in a luxurious / polluted / cheap / expensive hotel.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: POLLUTED.
'polluted' = ifloslangan — HAVO, SUV yoki
SHAHAR haqida aytiladi ('a polluted city'),
mehmonxona haqida emas.
'luxurious' = hashamatli.

items.textEn: 3  The nightlife is crowded / interesting / dull / boring.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: CROWDED.
'crowded' = gavjum — JOY haqida aytiladi
('a crowded street'), 'nightlife' esa
TUSHUNCHA (aniq joy emas).
'dull' = zerikarli ('boring' ning sinonimi).

items.textEn: 4  You can have dinner in a very romantic / clean / famous / delicious restaurant.
items.uz: Siz juda ... restoranda kechki ovqat qilishingiz mumkin.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: DELICIOUS.
'delicious' = mazali — faqat OVQAT haqida.
'a delicious dish' ✓
'a delicious restaurant' ✗
To'g'ri bo'lardi: 'a restaurant with delicious food'.

items.textEn: 5  The streets are dangerous / safe / crowded / friendly.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI: FRIENDLY.
'friendly' = do'stona — ODAMLAR haqida aytiladi
('friendly people', 'friendly staff'),
ko'chalar haqida emas.
Dangerous, safe, crowded — hammasi ko'cha uchun
to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda namunadagidek savol bering va javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'WHAT IS the museum LIKE in your town?'
  SB: 'It is a modern building.'
  SA: 'WHERE CAN I stay in your town?'
  SB: 'You can stay in a luxurious hotel.'


IKKI SAVOL QOLIPI:

  1) 'What is X LIKE in your town?'
     = Shahringizda X qanday?
     DIQQAT: 'like' bu yerda 'yoqtirmoq' EMAS —
     TASVIRLASh so'raydi.
     Coursebook 85-betdagi 15-mashqda ham
     shu qolip bor edi ('What was New York like?').

  2) 'Where can I + fe'l ... in your town?'
     = Shahringizda qayerda ... qilishim mumkin?


BESh SAVOL-JAVOB (1a-mashqning gaplaridan):

  1  SA: What is the museum like in your town?
     SB: It is a modern building.        (NAMUNA)

  2  SA: Where can I stay in your town?
     SB: You can stay in a luxurious hotel. (NAMUNA)

  3  SA: What is the nightlife like in your town?
     SB: It is very interesting.

  4  SA: Where can I have dinner in your town?
     SB: You can have dinner in a very famous
         restaurant.

  5  SA: What are the streets like in your town?
     SB: They are safe but crowded.


DIQQAT — 'IS' va 'ARE':
  'What IS the museum like?'   (birlik)
  'What ARE the streets like?' (ko'plik)
  Javobda ham: 'IT is ...' / 'THEY are ...'

modelSentences.sentence: SA: What is the museum like in your town? — SB: It is a modern building.
modelSentences.uz: Shahringizda muzey qanday? — U zamonaviy bino. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

modelSentences.sentence: SA: Where can I stay in your town? — SB: You can stay in a luxurious hotel.
modelSentences.uz: Shahringizda qayerda turishim mumkin? — Hashamatli mehmonxonada turishingiz mumkin. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

modelSentences.sentence: SA: What is the nightlife like in your town? — SB: It is very interesting.
modelSentences.uz: Shahringizda tungi hayot qanday? — U juda qiziqarli.

modelSentences.sentence: SA: Where can I have dinner in your town? — SB: You can have dinner in a very famous restaurant.
modelSentences.uz: Shahringizda qayerda kechki ovqat qilishim mumkin? — Juda mashhur restoranda ovqatlanishingiz mumkin.

modelSentences.sentence: SA: What are the streets like in your town? — SB: They are safe but crowded.
modelSentences.uz: Shahringizda ko'chalar qanday? — Ular xavfsiz, lekin gavjum. (KO'PLIK → 'are' va 'they')

exercises.instructionEn: Match the words in Column A to the words in Column B to make collocations.
exercises.instructionUz: So'z birikmalari hosil qilish uchun A ustundagi so'zlarni B ustundagi so'zlarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI USTUN:

  COLUMN A          COLUMN B
  1 designer        a trip
  2 film            b weather
  3 heavy           c star
  4 unforgettable   d people
  5 sunny           e clothes
  6 double-decker   f dishes
  7 tasty           g bus
  8 friendly        h traffic


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1 → e   designer clothes      (dizayner kiyimlar)
  2 → c   film star             (kino yulduzi)
  3 → h   heavy traffic         (zich transport oqimi)
  4 → a   unforgettable trip    (unutilmas sayohat)
  5 → b   sunny weather         (quyoshli ob-havo)
  6 → g   double-decker bus     (ikki qavatli avtobus)
  7 → f   tasty dishes          (mazali taomlar)
  8 → d   friendly people       (do'stona odamlar)


HAMMASI Unit 12 DAN:
  designer clothes  — Coursebook 83, 84-betlar
  film star         — Coursebook 83, 84-betlar
  heavy traffic     — Coursebook 83, 84-betlar
  sunny weather     — Coursebook 83, 84-betlar
  double-decker bus — Coursebook 87-bet
  friendly people   — Coursebook 87-bet


DIQQAT — 1a-MAShQ BILAN BOG'LIQ:
  1a-mashqda 'heavy building' va 'friendly
  streets' NOTO'G'RI edi.
  Bu yerda esa 'heavy TRAFFIC' va 'friendly
  PEOPLE' — TO'G'RI birikmalar.
  Ya'ni bir sifat bir ot bilan to'g'ri,
  boshqasi bilan noto'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin.


DIQQAT — BIRINChI SO'Z KO'PLIK BO'LMAYDI:
  'FILM star' ('films star' XATO)
  'DOUBLE-DECKER bus' (chiziqcha bilan)
  Ot + ot birikmasida birinchi ot BIRLIKDA
  qoladi.

pairs.whyUz:
'designer clothes' = dizayner kiyimlar.
Coursebook 83-betdagi maqolada:
'Do you want designer clothes? Then go to the
expensive shops on Rodeo Drive.'

'film star' = kino yulduzi.
DIQQAT: 'FILM' BIRLIKDA qoladi
('films star' XATO).
Coursebook 83-bet: 'It's also home to FILM STARS'.

'heavy traffic' = zich transport oqimi.
DIQQAT: 1a-mashqda 'heavy BUILDING' NOTO'G'RI
edi, lekin 'heavy TRAFFIC' TO'G'RI.
Coursebook 83-bet, G rasmi.

'an unforgettable trip' = unutilmas sayohat.
Coursebook 83-bet: 'A visit there is always
UNFORGETTABLE.'
4-mashqda sinonimi: 'memorable'.

'sunny weather' = quyoshli ob-havo.
Coursebook 83-bet: 'It's also home to film stars,
SUNNY WEATHER, tall buildings and heavy traffic.'

'a double-decker bus' = ikki qavatli avtobus.
Britaniyaning mashhur transporti.
Coursebook 87-bet: 'get on an open-topped
DOUBLE-DECKER BUS'.

'tasty dishes' = mazali taomlar.
'tasty' = 'delicious' ning sinonimi.
DIQQAT: 1a-mashqda 'delicious RESTAURANT'
NOTO'G'RI edi — mazali bo'ladigan narsa TAOM.

'friendly people' = do'stona odamlar.
DIQQAT: 1a-mashqda 'friendly STREETS' NOTO'G'RI
edi — 'friendly' ODAMLAR haqida aytiladi.
Coursebook 85-bet: 'The people were really friendly.'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the opposites of the adjectives in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qalin yozilgan sifatlarning ZIDLARI bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAR SAVOLDA QALIN sifat bor —
javobda uning ZIDINI yozish kerak.

Javob DOIM 'No, ...' bilan boshlanadi —
ya'ni savoldagi sifat NOTO'G'RI.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  quiet    →  NOISY       (tinch → shovqinli)
  2  big      →  SMALL       (katta → kichik)
  3  safe     →  DANGEROUS   (xavfsiz → xavfli)
  4  dirty    →  CLEAN       (iflos → toza)
  5  modern   →  OLD         (zamonaviy → eski)
  6  boring   →  EXCITING    (zerikarli → qiziqarli)
  7  cheap    →  EXPENSIVE   (arzon → qimmat)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  A: Nyu-York tinch shaharmi?
     B: Yo'q, u juda shovqinli.
  2  A: Katta uydami yashaysiz?
     B: Yo'q, men kichkina uyda yashayman.
  3  A: Kechasi yolg'iz yurish xavfsizmi?
     B: Yo'q, ancha xavfli.
  4  A: Mamlakatingizdagi plyajlar iflosmi?
     B: Yo'q, ular juda toza.
  5  A: Venesiyada ko'p zamonaviy binolar bormi?
     B: Yo'q, ko'p eski binolar bor.
  6  A: Venadagi tungi hayot zerikarlimi?
     B: Yo'q, u juda qiziqarli.
  7  A: Milandagi do'konlar arzonmi?
     B: Yo'q, ular ancha qimmat.


HAMMA ZID JUFTLIKLAR Coursebook 82-BETDAGI
1-MAShQDAN:
     quiet   ↔  noisy
     clean   ↔  dirty
     tall    ↔  small
     cheap   ↔  expensive
     modern  ↔  old
     exciting ↔ boring
  Faqat 'safe ↔ dangerous' yangi
  (Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda 'safe = not
   dangerous' berilgan edi).


DIQQAT — KUChAYTIRUVChILARGA E'TIBOR BERING:
  'it's VERY noisy'      (juda)
  'it's QUITE dangerous' (ancha)
  'they are VERY clean'  (juda)
  'they are QUITE expensive' (ancha)
  Bularning hammasi ODDIY sifat bilan keladi
  (Grammar 52-bet qoidasi).


JOY NOMLARI:
  New York — AQSh
  Venice   — Venesiya, Italiya (eski binolari bilan
             mashhur)
  Vienna   — Vena, Avstriya poytaxti
  Milan    — Milan, Italiya (moda markazi)

items.textEn: 1  A: Is New York a QUIET city?  B: No, it's very ............ .
items.whyUz:
quiet (tinch) ↔ NOISY (shovqinli).
Coursebook 82-betdagi 1-mashqning birinchi
juftligi.
'very' + ODDIY sifat.

items.textEn: 2  A: Do you live in a BIG house?  B: No, I live in a ............ house.
items.whyUz:
big (katta) ↔ SMALL (kichik).
DIQQAT: bo'shliqdan keyin 'house' turibdi →
sifat otdan OLDIN keladi.

items.textEn: 3  A: Is it SAFE to walk alone at night?  B: No, it's quite ............ .
items.whyUz:
safe (xavfsiz) ↔ DANGEROUS (xavfli).
Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda:
'safe = not dangerous'.
'quite' + ODDIY sifat.

items.textEn: 4  A: Are the beaches in your country DIRTY?  B: No, they are very ............ .
5  A: Has Venice got many MODERN buildings?  B: No, there are lots of ............ buildings.
items.whyUz:
modern (zamonaviy) ↔ OLD (eski).
Venesiya — eski binolari bilan mashhur.
'lots of' = ko'p (= 'a lot of').

items.textEn: 6  A: Is the nightlife in Vienna BORING?  B: No, it's very ............ .
items.whyUz:
boring (zerikarli) ↔ EXCITING (qiziqarli).
Coursebook 82-betdagi 1-mashqda 'nightlife'
juftligi aynan 'exciting - boring' edi.
Vena — Avstriya poytaxti.

items.textEn: 7  A: Are the shops in Milan CHEAP?  B: No, they are quite ............ .
items.whyUz:
cheap (arzon) ↔ EXPENSIVE (qimmat).
Milan — Italiyaning moda markazi,
qimmat do'konlari bilan mashhur.
'the shops' KO'PLIK → 'THEY ARE'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use words from the list to write the synonyms of the underlined words in the spaces below.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlardan foydalanib, tagi chizilgan so'zlarning sinonimlarini quyidagi bo'sh joylarga yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta):
  boring, fascinating, areas, well-known,
  unforgettable, quiet


MATN (tagi chizilgan so'zlar QALIN):

  A visit to Paris is a 1) MEMORABLE experience.
  Here you can see lots of 2) INTERESTING sights or
  enjoy lunch in one of the many 3) FAMOUS
  restaurants in the city. Paris has a large number
  of different 4) DISTRICTS you can visit and many
  excellent shops where you can buy fashionable
  clothes.

  The nightlife in Paris is very popular with
  visitors. You can spend an evening at the theatre,
  enjoy a drink in a cafe or go for a 5) PEACEFUL
  walk along the riverside.

  Don't miss the chance to visit Paris! There is
  never a 6) DULL moment.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  Parijga tashrif — unutilmas tajriba. Bu yerda
  ko'plab maftunkor diqqatga sazovor joylarni
  ko'rishingiz yoki shahardagi ko'plab mashhur
  restoranlarning birida tushlik qilishingiz
  mumkin. Parijda borib ko'rish mumkin bo'lgan
  turli hududlar juda ko'p, hamda moda kiyimlar
  sotib olish mumkin bo'lgan a'lo do'konlar bor.

  Parijdagi tungi hayot sayyohlar orasida juda
  mashhur. Kechqurunni teatrda o'tkazishingiz,
  kafeda ichimlik ichishingiz yoki daryo bo'ylab
  tinch sayr qilishingiz mumkin.

  Parijga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang!
  Hech qachon zerikarli daqiqa bo'lmaydi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  memorable    →  UNFORGETTABLE  (unutilmas)
  2  interesting  →  FASCINATING    (maftunkor)
  3  famous       →  WELL-KNOWN     (yaxshi tanilgan)
  4  districts    →  AREAS          (hududlar)
  5  peaceful     →  QUIET          (tinch)
  6  dull         →  BORING         (zerikarli)


DIQQAT — Coursebook 84-BETDAGI 7-MAShQ BILAN
BOG'LIQ:
  U yerda sinonimlar TESKARI yo'nalishda berilgan
  edi:
     unforgettable = memorable
     fascinating   = interesting
     famous        = well-known
     area          = district
  Bu yerda esa AYNAN o'sha juftliklar,
  faqat teskari tomondan.
  Faqat 'peaceful = quiet' va 'dull = boring'
  yangi.


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDA KO'PLIK:
  Matnda 'districts' KO'PLIK → javob ham KO'PLIK:
  'AREAS' ('area' emas).


DIQQAT — MATN Coursebook 87-BETDAGI STRATFORD
MAQOLASI QOLIPIDA:
  'Don't miss the chance to visit Paris!'
  Stratford maqolasining oxiri:
  'Don't miss the chance to visit it.'
  Bir xil tugallanma qolipi.


RASMDA: Parijdagi Zafar darvozasi
  (the Arc de Triomphe) va uning atrofidagi
  gavjum yo'l.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  memorable   = esda qolarli
  an experience = tajriba
  a district  = tuman, hudud
  an area     = hudud
  peaceful    = tinch, osoyishta
  dull        = zerikarli
  a moment    = daqiqa, lahza

items.sentence: 1  A visit to Paris is a MEMORABLE experience.  →  ............

commonMistake.whyUz:
memorable = UNFORGETTABLE (unutilmas).
'memorable' — 'memory' (xotira) dan,
'unforgettable' — un + forget + able.
Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda ham shu juftlik.

items.sentence: 2  Here you can see lots of INTERESTING sights.  →  ............

commonMistake.whyUz:
interesting = FASCINATING (maftunkor).
'fascinating' — 'interesting' ning KUCHLIROQ
shakli.
Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda ham shu juftlik.

items.sentence: 3  ... enjoy lunch in one of the many FAMOUS restaurants.  →  ............

commonMistake.whyUz:
famous = WELL-KNOWN (yaxshi tanilgan).
Chiziqcha bilan yoziladi.
Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda ham shu juftlik.

items.sentence: 4  Paris has a large number of different DISTRICTS you can visit.  →  ............

commonMistake.whyUz:
districts = AREAS (hududlar).
DIQQAT: matnda KO'PLIK ('districts') →
javob ham KO'PLIK: 'AREAS' ('area' emas).
Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda 'area = district'.

items.sentence: 5  ... or go for a PEACEFUL walk along the riverside.  →  ............

commonMistake.whyUz:
peaceful = QUIET (tinch, osoyishta).
Coursebook 87-betdagi Stratford maqolasida ham
'enjoy the PEACEFULNESS of the place' bor edi.

items.sentence: 6  There is never a DULL moment.  →  ............

commonMistake.whyUz:
dull = BORING (zerikarli).
1a-mashqda ham ikkalasi bir qatorda edi
('interesting/dull/boring').
'There is never a dull moment' — turg'un ibora:
'hech qachon zerikmaysiz'.

exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI BAND — HAMMASI PREDLOG haqida.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  B  to     (home TO)
  2  A  with   (popular WITH)
  3  A  at     (eat AT)
  4  C  to     (close TO)
  5  C  with   (packed WITH)
  6  C  in     (IN Park Street)
  7  C  in     (IN Athens)


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  LA ko'plab kino yulduzlarining makoni.
  2  Bu qal'a sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur.
  3  Kecha kechqurun meksika restoranida
     ovqatlandik.
  4  Uyim temir yo'l vokzaliga yaqin.
  5  Shahar sayyohlar bilan to'lib ketgan.
  6  Park ko'chasida arzon do'konlarni topishingiz
     mumkin.
  7  Plaka — Afinadagi mashhur sayyohlik hududi.


BESh TURG'UN BIRIKMA — YODLASh KERAK:

  be home TO ...    = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq
  popular WITH ...  = ... orasida mashhur
  eat AT ...        = ... da ovqatlanmoq
  close TO ...      = ... ga yaqin
  packed WITH ...   = ... bilan to'lib ketgan

  Bularning HAMMASI Coursebook 84-betdagi
  6-mashqda ham bor edi.


DIQQAT — 6-BAND: 'IN' yoki 'ON'?
  'You can find cheap shops ...... Park Street.'

  BRITANIYA inglizchasida:  IN ... Street
  AMERIKA inglizchasida:    ON ... Street

  Variantlar: at / of / in →
  'ON' berilmagan, shuning uchun javob 'IN'.

  DIQQAT — SOLIShTIRING:
  Coursebook 84-bet, 6-mashq:
     'ON Rodeo Drive'  (AMERIKA — LA haqida)
  Bu yerda:
     'IN Park Street'  (BRITANIYA)
  Ikkalasi ham TO'G'RI — faqat turli variantlar.


DIQQAT — 4-BAND:
  'close TO' — DOIM 'to' bilan.
  'close of' yoki 'close on' XATO.
  Coursebook 84-bet, 7-mashqda sinonimi:
  'close = near' ('near' esa predlogSIZ:
  'near the station').


DIQQAT — 7-BAND:
  'a tourist area IN Athens' — hudud ShAHAR
  ichida → IN.
  Plaka — Afinadagi eski shahar hududi
  (Akropol etagida).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a train station = temir yo'l vokzali
  a tourist       = sayyoh
  Athens          = Afina (Yunoniston poytaxti)
  Plaka           = Plaka (Afinadagi eski hudud)

items.textEn: 1  L.A. is home ............ many film stars.
items.whyUz:
B — 'be home TO ...' turg'un birikma
(... ning makoni bo'lmoq).
'home OF' XATO.
Coursebook 83-betdagi maqola:
'It's also home TO film stars.'

items.textEn: 2  This castle is very popular ............ visitors.
items.uz: Bu qal'a sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur.
items.whyUz:
A — 'popular WITH ...' turg'un birikma
(... orasida mashhur).
Coursebook 83-bet: '24-hour cafes ... are
POPULAR WITH visitors.'

items.textEn: 3  We ate ............ a Mexican restaurant last night.
items.whyUz:
A — 'eat AT a restaurant' turg'un birikma.
Coursebook 83-bet: 'restaurants you can EAT AT',
'EAT AT the Border Grill'.
Grammar 55-bet, 12-mashqning 4-bandi ham shu.

items.textEn: 4  My house is close ............ the train station.
items.whyUz:
C — 'close TO ...' turg'un birikma (... ga yaqin).
DOIM 'to' bilan.
DIQQAT: sinonimi 'near' esa predlogSIZ:
'near the station'.
Coursebook 87-bet: 'close TO special bus-stops'.

C — 'packed WITH ...' turg'un birikma
(... bilan to'lib ketgan).
TO'LGANLIK doim WITH bilan.
Coursebook 83-bet: 'the Buffalo Club, a place
PACKED WITH celebrities'.

items.textEn: 6  You can find cheap shops ............ Park Street.
items.uz: Park ko'chasida arzon do'konlarni topishingiz mumkin.
items.whyUz:
C — BRITANIYA inglizchasida ko'cha bilan 'IN':
'IN Park Street'.
DIQQAT — SOLISHTIRING:
Coursebook 84-bet, 6-mashqda 'ON Rodeo Drive'
edi — bu AMERIKA varianti (LA haqida).
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri; bu yerda 'on' variantlar
orasida berilmagan.

items.textEn: 7  Plaka is a popular tourist area ............ Athens.
items.whyUz:
C — hudud SHAHAR ichida → IN.
'IN Athens' = Afinada.
Plaka — Afinaning eski shahar hududi
(Akropol etagida).
DIQQAT: 2-bandda 'popular WITH visitors' edi,
bu yerda esa 'area IN Athens' — boshqa qoida.

groups.explanationUz: Ma'lum sifatlar ma'lum otlar bilan birga keladi.
Grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin g'alati eshitiladi.

items.derived: LA is home to film stars.

patterns.formula: What IS/ARE + [ot] LIKE in your town?  —  It IS / They ARE + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: What is the museum like in your town? — It is a modern building.
patterns.exampleUz: Shahringizda muzey qanday? — U zamonaviy bino.
patterns.explanationUz:
'like' bu yerda TASVIRLASH so'raydi
('yoqtirmoq' EMAS).
Ot ko'plik bo'lsa: 'What ARE ... like?'

patterns.formula: Where can I + fe'l ... in your town?  —  You can + fe'l ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Where can I stay in your town? — You can stay in a luxurious hotel.
patterns.exampleUz: Shahringizda qayerda turishim mumkin? — Hashamatli mehmonxonada turishingiz mumkin.

patterns.formula: Is X + [sifat]?  —  No, it's very/quite + [ZID sifat].
patterns.exampleEn: Is New York a quiet city? — No, it's very noisy.
patterns.exampleUz: Nyu-York tinch shaharmi? — Yo'q, u juda shovqinli.
patterns.explanationUz:
'No' bilan javob berilsa — zid sifat ishlatiladi.
'very' va 'quite' ODDIY sifat bilan keladi.

patterns.formula: X is home TO ... / popular WITH ... / close TO ... / packed WITH ... .
patterns.exampleEn: L.A. is home to many film stars. The town is packed with tourists.
patterns.exampleUz: LA ko'plab kino yulduzlarining makoni. Shahar sayyohlar bilan to'lib ketgan.
patterns.explanationUz:
TURG'UN birikmalar — predlogi o'zgarmaydi,
yodlash kerak.

patterns.formula: Don't miss the chance to visit ...! There is never a dull moment.
patterns.exampleEn: Don't miss the chance to visit Paris! There is never a dull moment.
patterns.exampleUz: Parijga borish imkoniyatini boy bermang! Hech qachon zerikmaysiz.
patterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat maqolasining TUGALLANMASI —
Coursebook 87-betdagi Stratford maqolasi bilan
bir xil qolip.
